schema.category: engine-defect (the parent engine broke a rule; the fix engine follows it) or test-expectation (a rule test expected a wrong value; the fix corrected the expectation)
schema.parent: full commit id of the fix's first parent
schema.fix: full commit id of the fix

rule.source: RULEBOOK.md section or card spec path
rule.text: the rule sentence that decides the case

observable.pointer: RFC 6901 pointer into the referee's normalized output

schema.parentExpected: test-expectation only: the value the old test asserted
schema.fixExpected: test-expectation only: the value the corrected test asserts
schema.prefix: why the actions in the blind input are the minimal legal prefix
